scripts.db:migrate: cd packages/database && bunx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: cd packages/database && bunx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:migrate:status: cd packages/database && bunx prisma migrate status
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/database/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server/tsconfig.json
